note: Set A captures the full state-space equations (7-4), the discrete time step of 0.0125 s, and correctly binds A_d=α, B_d=1−α, C_d=α, D_d=1−α, plus the 0.25 Hz corner frequency with its one-quarter-of-first-edgewise-natural-frequency condition. Set B misbinds B_d=1−α to the "discrete-time state matrix" and D_d=1−α to "discrete-time input", and contains contradictory duplicate readings at 1.00 Hz (phase −75 vs −80 deg; magnitude −13 vs −12.5 dB). Set A's main faults are two plot readings placed at ≈0.3 Hz although the text fixes the −3 dB/−45 deg point at 0.25 Hz, and one garbled condition ("roughly first edgewise natural frequency" instead of one-quarter of it). Set B also omits the 0.0125 s time step and the state/output equations, and both sets use the unsupported entity name "Baseline/Control-Measurement Filter".
